title: Hypothyroidism Treated With Calcitonin
brief_summary: Some people with hypothyroidism have persistent symptoms despite adequate treatment with thyroid hormones. We are testing whether giving calcitonin to such people will improve their quality of life.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Normal TSH on levothyroxine therapy

Exclusion Criteria:

1. pregnant or 6 months post partum
2. Current or previous thyroid cancer
3. Congenital hypothyroidism
4. any tobacco use
5. prescribed proton pump inhibitors
6. prescribed steroids
7. taking armour thyroid, naturethroid, or any dessicated thyroid hormone
8. Unstable medical conditions (CKD, Cirrhosis etc)
9. pituitary disease
